verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support for settlement legibility. The Checkouts API exposes 'settlement details', deposits auto-credit the custodial account balance, USDC can be auto-converted to USD in a treasury, and webhooks give real-time event notifications that could feed reconciliation. Nothing documents payment-to-available-balance timing, a fee schedule for the ACH/Fedwire/Swift/SEPA payout rails (only a 'no gas fees' claim for stablecoin acceptance), or exportable statements and accounting reports. Missing for 10: documented settlement timing from payment to available balance, published per-rail fees, statements or accounting-ready reports/exports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
